frame.note: x=0 is the team's own alliance wall, +x toward the opponent wall; y follows WPILib after the symmetry transform; *_norm values are 0..1 of the full field

legend: Zone state machine on smoothed alliance-perspective x: own = x <= 3.73 m (alliance zone minus 0.3 m), neutral = 5.52–11.02 m (between the two barriers, 0.3 m in); the barrier (hub, bumps, trench) and the opponent's zone change nothing. A zone counts after 1 s of dwell. One cycle = a counted neutral visit then a counted own-zone visit; ranked on teleop cycles per tracked teleop minute (pooled over counted matches). A tracking gap > 3 s resets the machine (counted as a reset), so trips across gaps are never invented — low-coverage matches undercount. Cycle time = neutral entry to the next neutral entry. Positions are median-smoothed over 1 s; speed = smoothed displacement across a centred 1 s window ÷ its duration, never across a tracking gap > 0.6 s or a tracker-slot change. Runs of bit-identical positions longer than 0.5 s are stalled tracking: if the robot is still within 0.3 m of that spot when tracking resumes it sat still (counted as stationary), otherwise those seconds are unknown and excluded. A match counts only with >= 30 s of valid tracking; fewer than 2 counted matches = low data.
